highlights.caseName: Sunil Kumar (Totally Disabled) v. IFFCO Tokio General Insurance Co. Ltd.
highlights.text: Needing a lifelong attendant can mean 100% functional disability.
Using children in election reels isn't undue influence.

highlights.caseName: Ram Sarup v. State of Punjab
highlights.text: Illegally sacked daily-wager gets compensation, not reinstatement.
No bail for officials accused in fake Aadhaar racket.

highlights.caseName: Suraj Singh v. State of U.P.
highlights.text: Retirement indemnity bond can't justify pay recovery.

items.caseName: Sunil Kumar (Totally Disabled) v. IFFCO Tokio General Insurance Co. Ltd.
items.headline: Lifelong attendant need can mean 100% disability
items.text: Claimant dependent on others treated as 100% functionally disabled despite a 75.5% medical rating; award raised to ₹77.84 lakh.

pages.title: Orders
pages.note: No Supreme Court interim order, stay or notice passed in this window was reported by the legal publications we track (18 October was a Sunday).

items.caseName: Suraj Singh v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Retirement indemnity bond can't justify pay recovery
items.text: Only an undertaking given when the wrong pay was fixed counts; recovery quashed, refund with interest ordered.

items.caseName: M/s Vikas Constructions v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Admitted contract dues recoverable by writ
items.text: Withholding dues the State admits is arbitrary; payment ordered with 6% interest.

items.caseName: M/s Balaji Construction v. State of U.P.
items.coram: Siddhartha Varma, Kunal Ravi Singh, JJ.
items.headline: Road work isn't township development experience
items.text: Tender eligibility can't be relaxed; cancellation of the bid process upheld on the records.

items.caseName: Rajeshwari Devi & Ors. v. Hari Shankar Pandey & Anr.
items.headline: Alleged affair doesn't end a woman's widow status
items.text: Widowhood follows from the marriage and husband's death; decree saying otherwise set aside.

items.caseName: Shashwat Kesarwani & Anr. v. Anil Kumar Singh & Ors.
items.headline: No fixed sale date: limitation runs from refusal
items.text: Where performance hinges on a future event, time runs from notice of refusal; Order VII Rule 11 plea rejected.

items.caseName: Dr. Pradeep Kumar Shukla v. Guru Ghasidas University
items.coram: Ramesh Sinha, CJ, Ravindra Kumar Agrawal, J.
items.headline: Probationer can be let go without an enquiry
items.text: Discharge for unsatisfactory work is not punitive and needs no Art. 311 enquiry; appeal dismissed.

items.headline: Children in poll reels aren't 'undue influence'
items.text: Election petition against the Salem North MLA rejected; breach of an ECI circular alone can't void a win.

items.caseName: Ram Sarup v. State of Punjab
items.coram: Suvir Sehgal, Deepinder Singh Nalwa, JJ.
items.headline: No automatic reinstatement for daily-wager
items.text: Illegal termination under S.25-F ID Act earns compensation; award doubled to ₹2 lakh.

items.headline: No bail for officials in fake Aadhaar case
items.text: Second bail refused to two programmers accused of sharing state network logins; HC cited national security.
